strings.title: HOST_LOCK
strings.subtitle: Skill: pulling a part out of text
strings.briefing:
A web analytics export stored the full address people visited: with and without https, with www, in capitals, sometimes with a port or a path.

The lock wants only the bare hostname, lower case: example.com, not HTTPS://WWW.EXAMPLE.COM:8080/shop?id=4.

Capture groups are the tool for this. Describe the whole address, put parentheses around the part you want to keep, and pull that part out. In pandas that is .str.extract(); in SQL it is REGEXP_EXTRACT(text, pattern).
